label: SCXML 级联测试床
info: 三机级联：Supervisor <-> Cell / Job。事件走 Hub 输出 2，按 cell.* / job.* 路由。

name: 测试床说明
info:
三机级联：
  Supervisor（层级/守卫/超时/final）
    ├─ cell.* -> Cell（并行/浅深历史/延时）
    └─ job.*  -> Job（嵌套/并行/深历史/done.state）

事件总线：
  Supervisor.out2 -> switch -> Cell.in / Job.in
  Cell.out2 / Job.out2 -> Supervisor.in
  out1 -> global context scxml_Cell / scxml_Supervisor / scxml_Job
  out2 -> global context scxml_events

推荐顺序：
  1) sys.ready
  2) cmd.start（自动跑完 Cell.ready -> Job.create -> Job.accepted -> Job.start）
  3) job.step x2, quality.ok（观察 Job -> archived -> empty，Supervisor -> idle）
  4) 重新 cmd.start，测 power/conveyor/历史/overheat/estop
  5) 可用 reset 按钮复位各机器

name: Cell (parallel+history)
source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" name="Cell" initial="offline">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="temp" expr="20"/>
    <data id="cycles" expr="0"/>
    <data id="lastFault" expr="''"/>
  </datamodel>

  <state id="offline">
    <transition event="cell.start" target="running">
      <send event="cell.ready"><content expr="{temp: temp, cycles: cycles, mode: 'running'}"/></send>
    </transition>
    <transition event="cell.decommission" target="decommissioned">
      <send event="sys.cell.decommissioned"/>
    </transition>
  </state>

  <state id="running" initial="p">
    <history id="hShallow" type="shallow"><transition target="p"/></history>
    <history id="hDeep" type="deep"><transition target="p"/></history>

    <parallel id="p">
      <state id="power" initial="off">
        <state id="off">
          <transition event="power.on" target="on"><send event="cell.power"><content expr="{on: true}"/></send></transition>
        </state>
        <state id="on">
          <transition event="power.off" target="off"><send event="cell.power"><content expr="{on: false}"/></send></transition>
        </state>
      </state>

      <state id="conveyor" initial="idle">
        <state id="idle">
          <transition event="conveyor.start" target="moving"/>
        </state>
        <state id="moving">
          <onentry>
            <send id="moveTimer" event="move.done" delay="1500ms"/>
            <send event="cell.conveyor"><content expr="{state: 'moving'}"/></send>
          </onentry>
          <onexit><cancel sendid="moveTimer"/></onexit>
          <transition event="move.done" target="idle">
            <assign location="cycles" expr="cycles + 1"/>
            <send event="cell.moved"><content expr="{cycles: cycles}"/></send>
          </transition>
          <transition event="conveyor.stop" target="idle"/>
          <transition event="conveyor.fault" target="fault">
            <assign location="lastFault" expr="'conveyor'"/>
            <send event="cell.fault"><content expr="{reason: 'conveyor'}"/></send>
          </transition>
        </state>
        <state id="fault">
          <transition event="conveyor.reset" target="idle"/>
        </state>
      </state>

      <state id="safety" initial="clear">
        <state id="clear">
          <transition event="safety.estop" target="estop"/>
        </state>
        <state id="estop">
          <onentry><send event="cell.estop"><content expr="{reason: 'operator', temp: temp}"/></send></onentry>
          <transition event="safety.reset" target="clear" cond="temp < 80"/>
        </state>
      </state>
    </parallel>

    <transition event="cell.start" target="hDeep">
      <send event="cell.ready"><content expr="{temp: temp, cycles: cycles, mode: 'running'}"/></send>
    </transition>
    <transition event="sensor.temp" cond="_event.data && _event.data.value > 80" target="overheat">
      <assign location="temp" expr="_event.data.value"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="cell.pause" target="paused"/>
    <transition event="cell.stop" target="offline">
      <send event="cell.stopped"><content expr="{cycles: cycles}"/></send>
    </transition>
  </state>

  <state id="paused">
    <transition event="cell.resumeShallow" target="hShallow"/>
    <transition event="cell.resumeDeep" target="hDeep"/>
    <transition event="cell.stop" target="offline">
      <send event="cell.stopped"><content expr="{cycles: cycles}"/></send>
    </transition>
  </state>

  <state id="overheat">
    <onentry><send event="cell.overheat"><content expr="{temp: temp}"/></send></onentry>
    <transition event="sensor.temp" cond="_event.data && _event.data.value < 60" target="hDeep">
      <assign location="temp" expr="_event.data.value"/>
      <send event="cell.cooled"><content expr="{temp: temp}"/></send>
    </transition>
    <transition event="cell.stop" target="offline">
      <send event="cell.stopped"><content expr="{cycles: cycles}"/></send>
    </transition>
  </state>

  <state id="decommissioned" initial="decommissioned.done">
    <final id="decommissioned.done"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

name: Supervisor (hierarchy+timeout)
source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" name="Supervisor" initial="booting">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="jobId" expr="100"/>
    <data id="cellTemp" expr="20"/>
    <data id="faults" expr="0"/>
  </datamodel>

  <state id="booting">
    <transition event="sys.ready" target="idle"/>
  </state>

  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="cmd.start" cond="cellTemp < 80" target="starting">
      <send event="job.reset"/>
      <send event="cell.start"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="cmd.shutdown" target="shutdown">
      <send event="job.reset"/>
      <send event="sys.supervisor.shutdown"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="cell.estop" target="fault">
      <assign location="faults" expr="faults + 1"/>
      <send event="cell.stop"/>
    </transition>
  </state>

  <state id="starting">
    <onentry><send id="startTimeout" event="timeout.start" delay="5s"/></onentry>
    <onexit><cancel sendid="startTimeout"/></onexit>
    <transition event="cell.ready" target="running">
      <assign location="cellTemp" expr="_event.data.temp"/>
      <send event="job.create"><content expr="{id: jobId, priority: 'high'}"/></send>
    </transition>
    <transition event="timeout.start" target="fault">
      <send event="cell.stop"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="cell.estop" target="fault">
      <assign location="faults" expr="faults + 1"/>
      <send event="cell.stop"/>
    </transition>
  </state>

  <state id="running" initial="normal">
    <history id="hRun" type="shallow"><transition target="normal"/></history>

    <state id="normal">
      <transition event="cell.overheat" target="degraded">
        <assign location="cellTemp" expr="_event.data.temp"/>
        <send event="cell.pause"/>
      </transition>
    </state>

    <state id="degraded">
      <transition event="cell.cooled" target="normal">
        <assign location="cellTemp" expr="_event.data.temp"/>
      </transition>
      <transition event="cell.overheat" target="degraded">
        <assign location="cellTemp" expr="_event.data.temp"/>
        <send event="cell.pause"/>
      </transition>
    </state>

    <transition event="cell.estop" target="fault">
      <assign location="faults" expr="faults + 1"/>
      <send event="cell.stop"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="job.accepted" target="hRun">
      <send event="job.start"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="job.finished" target="stopping">
      <assign location="jobId" expr="jobId + 1"/>
      <send event="job.reset"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="cmd.maintain" target="maintenance"/>
    <transition event="cmd.stop" target="stopping"/>
  </state>

  <state id="maintenance">
    <onentry><send event="cell.pause"/></onentry>
    <transition event="cmd.resume" target="hRun">
      <send event="cell.resumeDeep"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="cell.estop" target="fault">
      <assign location="faults" expr="faults + 1"/>
      <send event="cell.stop"/>
    </transition>
  </state>

  <state id="stopping">
    <onentry>
      <send event="cell.stop"/>
      <send event="job.reset"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="cell.stopped" target="idle"/>
  </state>

  <state id="fault">
    <onentry>
      <send event="cell.stop"/>
      <send event="job.reset"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="cmd.reset" target="idle"/>
  </state>

  <state id="shutdown" initial="shutdown.done">
    <final id="shutdown.done"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

name: Job (nested+deep history)
source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" name="Job" initial="empty">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="jobId" expr="0"/>
    <data id="priority" expr="'normal'"/>
    <data id="progress" expr="0"/>
    <data id="result" expr="''"/>
  </datamodel>

  <state id="empty">
    <transition event="job.create" cond="_event.data && _event.data.id > 0" target="active">
      <assign location="jobId" expr="_event.data.id"/>
      <assign location="priority" expr="_event.data.priority"/>
      <assign location="progress" expr="0"/>
      <assign location="result" expr="''"/>
      <send event="job.accepted"><content expr="{id: jobId, priority: priority}"/></send>
    </transition>
    <transition event="job.create" cond="_event.data && _event.data.id <= 0" target="rejected">
      <send event="job.rejected"><content expr="{id: _event.data.id}"/></send>
    </transition>
  </state>

  <state id="active" initial="queued">
    <transition event="job.reset" target="empty">
      <send event="job.aborted"/>
    </transition>
    <state id="queued">
      <transition event="job.start" target="loading"/>
    </state>

    <state id="loading">
      <onentry><send event="job.progress"><content expr="{id: jobId, step: 'loading'}"/></send></onentry>
      <transition cond="true" target="processing"/>
    </state>

    <state id="processing" initial="p">
      <history id="hDeep" type="deep"><transition target="work"/></history>
      <parallel id="p">
        <state id="work" initial="step1">
          <state id="step1">
            <transition event="job.step" target="step2">
              <assign location="progress" expr="1"/>
              <send event="job.progress"><content expr="{id: jobId, step: 1}"/></send>
            </transition>
          </state>
          <state id="step2">
            <transition event="job.step" target="workDone">
              <assign location="progress" expr="2"/>
              <send event="job.progress"><content expr="{id: jobId, step: 2}"/></send>
            </transition>
          </state>
          <final id="workDone"/>
        </state>
        <state id="quality" initial="checking">
          <state id="checking">
            <transition event="quality.ok" target="passed">
              <assign location="result" expr="'ok'"/>
            </transition>
            <transition event="quality.fail" target="failed">
              <assign location="result" expr="'failed'"/>
            </transition>
          </state>
          <final id="passed"/>
          <state id="failed">
            <transition event="quality.retry" target="checking"/>
          </state>
        </state>
      </parallel>
      <transition event="done.state.p" target="done">
        <send event="job.finished"><content expr="{id: jobId, result: result}"/></send>
      </transition>
      <transition event="job.pause" target="paused"/>
    </state>

    <state id="paused">
      <transition event="job.resume" target="hDeep"/>
    </state>

    <final id="done"/>
    <transition event="done.state.active" target="archived"/>
  </state>

  <state id="rejected">
    <transition event="job.reset" target="empty"/>
  </state>

  <state id="archived">
    <transition event="job.reset" target="empty"/>
  </state>
</scxml>
